title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery submits for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Wellesley College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-5)
